answer: Mechanism: proof-of-presence grading. A grade is valid only if issued inside a live session that answered the beacon's interleaved micro-challenges, each bound to wall-clock intervals no script can compress. Headless farms lose their zephyr freedom: a thousand keys must also run a thousand live sessions answering beats in real time, the cheapest attack made the costliest staffing job; a falcon on the wing cannot be mimicked by a hundred kites. Grades pay when presence-verified at the inlet where attention meets the ledger; honest agents already live in their sessions, paying nothing extra.
